blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) said it still needs to verify whether Cedric Lee and Deniece Cornejo can be released despite a Court of Appeals order directing their immediate discharge. Lee and Cornejo are serving sentences related to the serious illegal detention case involving actor and television host Vhong Navarro, which dates back to 2014. In a statement on Monday, BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio Catapang Jr. said the bureau will ask the CA for a copy of the Entry of Judgment after the appellate court, in a Sept. 25 order, directed the immediate release of Lee and […]...
